prompt: Image 1 is OUR stadium: copy its SCALE and architecture, not its composition: a gigantic 110,000-seat bowl, three tall steeply stacked decks of stands rising far above the pitch, a huge roof ring and a ring of floodlights, the players tiny against it, the stands packed to the last seat with tiny block fans. The stands show only plain club COLOURS (red-and-white sectors on one side, blue on the other), plain flat colour blocks, NEVER a crest, logo, emblem, lettering or mosaic picture. Image 2 is the CHARACTER and LOOK style: premium low-poly diorama game art, flat-shaded faceted polygons, chunky BLOCK people with box torso, box arms and legs, blocky hands and feet. Copy that look, not its composition. HEADS: every character has a ROUND head, a smooth faceted low-poly SPHERE (never a cube, never a flat disc, never bald), with low-poly HAIR on it in varied short cuts and colours (black, brown, blond, ginger, buzz cut, side parting, curls, one with a cap), and a simple low-poly face on the front of the head (two dot eyes, a nose bump, a small smile). Generic anonymous people. Everything faceted and flat-shaded, soft ambient occlusion, floodlight beams and light haze, teal-and-gold night colour grade, crisp clean render, NOT a photograph, NOT realistic. Vertical 9:16 frame. One team in plain red-and-white kits, the other in plain blue kits. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO crests, NO badges, NO signage, NO advertising boards, NO screens anywhere. Keep the top fifth of the frame clean and uncluttered. Scene: the moment of a goal, camera behind the goal net, a faceted low-poly football in the back of the net, the blue block goalkeeper with dark hair diving and sprawled on the grass beaten, red-and-white block players with varied hair arms raised celebrating, the colossal packed three-deck stadium of image 1 erupting behind, scarves raised, red flares and confetti, floodlight flares through haze. Only plain stands and crowd behind.
